_comment: The Relic case on the clinic workbench (Act 3, D102). No lines, no actors, no
tier: the scene exists only to hang one Use prompt on the case, which is how the
prologue makes a prop usable - q005_07_vip_apartment.scene's hub 4162 is an
attachToWorld scnChoiceNode with one option, captioned 'użyj'. The case itself
(ac_splinter_box in source/world.json) is scenery with no interaction of its own.
The quest graph's open_box node blocks on this scene until the option is picked,
D118: this is now the FIRST of two prompts on the same marker. This one opens the
case - the glue swaps the closed prop for q005_broken_suitcase.ent, which is the
opened case with the splinter lying in it - and scene_chip.json is the second,
which takes the splinter. One prompt that silently granted the item was the beat
the player could not see happening.

nodes._attachToWorld: offset is relative to the scene location #ac_box_origin, which sits on the case's base at the bench top; 0.2 m up puts the prompt on the lid. range is vanilla hub 4162's 2 m.
